A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed analytical approach is a very effective tool for designing HS-PMSMs, as it enables the computation of the mechanical stress distribution in the rotor, and the contact pressure distribution between rotor components (PMs and sleeve).
the proposed analytical method can be used to design the sleeve of the HS-PMSMs, in terms of the thickness, the material and the number of layers.
we have proposed a novel analytical procedure to design PM retention sleeves in HS-PMSMs, based on elastic mechanics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of Ferrite PMs in combination with Titanium sleeves leads to a significant stress reduction, thus enabling a higher speed operation.
the proposed analytical procedure is able to provide an accurate estimation of the Von Mises stresses in the sleeve, as well as of the contact pressures between rotor elements.
the employment of Ferrite-based PM and Titanium sleeve is the most advantageous solution in terms of PMs and sleeve materials, as well as in terms of manufacturing costs.
